info.name: Backend — Tasteep
info.description:
- **Tasteep** — spirit-tasting journal for the Flutter app. Routes `/auth/*` and `/tasteep/*`, bearer-token auth.

Set `base_url` in the environment (defaults to `http://localhost:3000`).

**Getting a token:** run **Tasteep — Auth → Request Email Code**, read the 6-digit code from the server log (or your inbox if SMTP is configured), put it in `tasteep_otp_code`, then run **Verify Email Code** — the token is saved into `tasteep_token` and reused by every other Tasteep request.

**Running the journal as a test suite:** the *Tastings → Atlas (phase 2) → Cleanup* folders are ordered and fully asserted. Run them with the Collection Runner, or headless with `TASTEEP_TOKEN=… npm run test:postman` (newman). Leave *Sign Out* for last — it revokes the token.

exec: console.log('Check the server log for the OTP code if SMTP is not configured, then set {{tasteep_otp_code}} and run Verify Email Code.');

request.description:
Step 1 of email login. Sends a 6-digit code (10 min TTL). Answers 429 if a code was sent in the last 60s.

If SMTP is not configured on the server, the code is printed in the server's console log instead of emailed.

exec: console.log('Saved tasteep_token and tasteep_user_id to the environment.');

request.description: Step 2 of email login. Set the environment variable `tasteep_otp_code` to the code from the server log or your inbox, then send. On success this saves `tasteep_token` for every other Tasteep request in this collection.
Body carries the ID token from the client's google_sign_in flow. Requires TASTEEP_GOOGLE_CLIENT_IDS to be configured server-side; 503 otherwise.

302 redirect to Discord's consent page. Open this in a browser, not via Send — Postman won't follow the app-deep-link redirect. Copy the `code` query param Discord appends to `discord_redirect_uri` and paste it into the `discord_code` environment variable.
Exchanges the authorization code from the redirect step. `redirect_uri` must match what was used to open the authorize page.
Restores/validates the current session. 401 if the token is expired, unknown, or was signed out.

exec: pm.test('no token is re-issued on /me', () => pm.expect(body.token).to.be.null);

request.description: Revokes this session server-side. The saved tasteep_token stops working immediately after this — re-run the email login requests to get a new one.

item.name: Tasteep — Tastings
item.description: Phase 1 journal CRUD. Needs `tasteep_token` (run the Auth folder first, or pass it to newman). Creates two tastings (`tasting_id`, `tasting_id_2`) that the Atlas folder builds on and the Cleanup folder deletes.

request.description: Newest date_tasted first, undated entries last. Only the caller's rows.

exec: pm.test('is a plain array (no envelope)', () => pm.expect(body).to.be.an('array'));
pm.test('every item has the full Tasting contract', () => body.forEach(expectTastingShape));
for (let i = 1; i < dated.length; i++) pm.expect(dated[i - 1] >= dated[i], `${dated[i - 1]} before ${dated[i]}`).to.be.true;

request.description: PUT is upsert. `:id` must be a UUID — the pre-request script generates `tasting_id` if the environment has none. Full replacement: any field you omit is stored as null.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Lagavulin 16",
  "category": "whisky",
  "photo_path": null,
  "distillery": "Lagavulin",
  "region": "Islay",
  "region_id": null,
  "abv": 43,
  "price": 65.5,
  "age_statement": "16",
  "cask_type": "Ex-bourbon & sherry",
  "date_tasted": "2026-03-10T19:00:00.000Z",
  "location": "Home",
  "score": 88,
  "appearance": "Deep amber",
  "tags": [
    "peat",
    "smoke"
  ],
  "nose": "Bonfire",
  "palate": "Iodine",
  "finish": "Long",
  "lat": null,
  "lon": null,
  "location_precision": "unknown"
}

exec: pm.test('has the full Tasting contract', () => expectTastingShape(body));
pm.test('numbers come back as numbers', () => { pm.expect(body.abv).to.eql(43); pm.expect(body.price).to.eql(65.5); pm.expect(body.score).to.eql(88); });

request.description: A second entry (different distillery, older date, `country` precision with coordinates) so the list order, the unplaced shelf and stats have something to show.

exec: pm.test('coordinates and precision stored', () => { pm.expect(body.lat).to.eql(56.49); pm.expect(body.lon).to.eql(-4.2); pm.expect(body.location_precision).to.eql('country'); });

request.description: 404 for an id that does not exist or belongs to another account.

exec: pm.test('has the full Tasting contract', () => expectTastingShape(body));

request.description: Replaces the same row. Fields omitted here (region, abv, price, ...) are cleared to null — this endpoint is not a PATCH.

exec: pm.test('omitted fields are cleared (PUT, not PATCH)', () => { pm.expect(body.region).to.be.null; pm.expect(body.abv).to.be.null; pm.expect(body.date_tasted).to.be.null; });
pm.test('defaults apply to the non-nullable fields', () => { pm.expect(body.category).to.eql('whisky'); pm.expect(body.location_precision).to.eql('unknown'); });
pm.test('updated_at bumped past created_at', () => pm.expect(body.updated_at >= body.created_at).to.be.true);

request.description: Validation: empty name, score above 100 and an unknown precision. The row is left untouched.

exec: pm.test('message lists every failing field', () => { pm.expect(body.message).to.be.an('array'); ['name', 'score', 'location_precision'].forEach((f) => pm.expect(body.message.join(' ')).to.include(f)); });

item.name: Tasteep — Atlas (phase 2)
item.description: The Places backend: geocoding via Nominatim (cache-first, 1 req/s server-wide), the per-tasting location route with its manual-pin protection, the "NOT PLACED" shelf, and the stats aggregate. Runs after the Tastings folder; expects `tasting_id` and `tasting_id_2` to exist.

request.description: Only `location_precision` in `unknown`/`country` — the Atlas "NOT PLACED" shelf (`unknown` → SET LOCATION, `country` → REFINE). Both tastings created above qualify at this point.

exec: pm.test('both fresh tastings are on the shelf', () => { pm.expect(ids).to.include(pm.environment.get('tasting_id')); pm.expect(ids).to.include(pm.environment.get('tasting_id_2')); });

request.description: Cache-first Nominatim lookup. The first ever run of a query hits Nominatim (max 1 req/s for the whole server); every later run of the same normalised query is served from `tasteep_geocode_cache`. 503 if `TASTEEP_NOMINATIM_USER_AGENT` is not configured server-side. Saves the result into `geocode_*` for the next requests.

exec: pm.test('coordinates are in range', () => { pm.expect(body.lat).to.be.within(-90, 90); pm.expect(body.lon).to.be.within(-180, 180); });
pm.test('Islay lands in the Hebrides', () => { pm.expect(body.lat).to.be.within(55.5, 56.0); pm.expect(body.lon).to.be.within(-6.6, -5.9); });

request.description: Same place, different casing and whitespace: normalised to the same cache key, so this never reaches Nominatim.
A miss is cached as `unknown` too, so the same query never hits Nominatim again.
Validation only — Nominatim is not called.

What the client does after a geocode: store the result on the tasting. The tasting is `unknown` at this point, so an automated precision is accepted. The body is built from the `geocode_*` variables saved by "Geocode a Place" (raw JSON, numbers unquoted — see the pre-request script).

exec: // Postman variables are strings inside a raw body; rebuild the JSON so lat/lon stay numbers.
pm.test('returns the full updated tasting', () => expectTastingShape(body));

request.description: A pin drop. Always accepted, and future automated geocode results will not overwrite it (see next requests).

exec: pm.test('pin stored as manual', () => { pm.expect(body.lat).to.eql(55.63); pm.expect(body.lon).to.eql(-6.13); pm.expect(body.location_precision).to.eql('manual'); });

request.description: The manual-pin protection, enforced server-side: an automated result never overwrites a manual pin.

exec: pm.test('rejected because the tasting has a manual pin', () => pm.response.to.have.status(409));

request.description: The same protection on the full upsert: a body carrying an automated precision does not move a manual pin. (Sending `manual` with new coordinates would move it.)

exec: pm.test('manual pin survived the upsert', () => { pm.expect(body.lat).to.eql(55.63); pm.expect(body.lon).to.eql(-6.13); pm.expect(body.location_precision).to.eql('manual'); });
pm.test('the rest of the body was applied', () => pm.expect(body.region).to.eql('Islay'));

request.description: A second manual pin replaces the first.
lat/lon are required for every precision except `unknown`.
Clears lat/lon even over a manual pin — this is the one precision value that always wins. The tasting is back on the "NOT PLACED" shelf.
Once the pin is cleared, automated results are accepted again.
`tasting_id` is now `region`, so it left the shelf; `tasting_id_2` (`country`) is still there.

exec: pm.test('country-precision tasting is still on it', () => pm.expect(ids).to.include(pm.environment.get('tasting_id_2')));

request.description: The curated region picker: countries in seed order, each with `subregions` (may be empty). Every row carries an approximate centroid `lat`/`lon` — the Atlas uses it as the fallback pin for a tasting that has no resolved location. Send the returned `ETag` back as `If-None-Match` to get a bodyless `304`. Stores the Islay id in `region_id` for the next request.

exec: pm.test('country rows have the exact shape', () => pm.expect(Object.keys(tree[0]).sort()).to.eql(['id', 'lat', 'lon', 'name', 'subregions']));

pm.test('Scotland is there with its whisky regions', () => { pm.expect(scotland.name).to.eql('Scotland'); pm.expect(scotland.subregions.map((s) => s.id)).to.include.members(['scotland/speyside', 'scotland/islay', 'scotland/campbeltown']); });

pm.test('subregion rows have the exact shape and a centroid', () => { pm.expect(Object.keys(islay).sort()).to.eql(['id', 'lat', 'lon', 'name']); pm.expect(islay.lat).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(islay.lon).to.be.a('number'); });
pm.test('a country without subregions has an empty list', () => pm.expect(tree.find((r) => r.id === 'sweden').subregions).to.eql([]));

request.description: Same call with the ETag from the previous request; expects `304` and no body.

exec: // Newman runs requests in order; grab the ETag with a direct call so this request is self-contained.

pm.sendRequest({ url: pm.variables.replaceIn('{{base_url}}/tasteep/regions'), method: 'GET', header: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + pm.environment.get('tasteep_token') } }, (err, res) => { if (!err) pm.environment.set('regions_etag', res.headers.get('ETag')); });

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Ardbeg 10",
  "category": "whisky",
  "photo_path": null,
  "distillery": "Ardbeg",
  "region": null,
  "region_id": "{{region_id}}",
  "abv": 46,
  "price": 48,
  "age_statement": "10",
  "cask_type": null,
  "date_tasted": "2025-12-25T18:00:00.000Z",

}

request.description: `region_id` from the picker wins and, with `region` left null, the server fills the text with the region's name. An unknown `region_id` is a `400`. Free text that matches a known name (e.g. `"Islay"`) is linked automatically; anything else is kept as typed with `region_id: null`.

exec: pm.test('region text filled from the picker', () => pm.expect(body.region).to.eql('Islay'));

request.description: `{count, avg_score, distinct_distilleries}` for the Profile stat grid. `avg_score` is null when no scored tasting exists.

exec: pm.test('avg_score is a 1-decimal number between 0 and 100', () => { pm.expect(body.avg_score).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(body.avg_score).to.be.within(0, 100); pm.expect(Math.round(body.avg_score * 10) / 10).to.eql(body.avg_score); });

request.description: Every live SMWS code for the offline copy: `{ version, items }`. `version` is the hex SHA-256 of `JSON.stringify(items)`, so the app can re-hash its stored copy to check it. Send the returned `ETag` back as `If-None-Match` to get a bodyless `304`.

exec: pm.test('has a version and at least the seeded codes', () => { pm.expect(body.version).to.match(/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/); pm.expect(body.items.length).to.be.at.least(240); });

item.name: Tasteep — Cleanup
item.description: Removes the two tastings the run created so it can be repeated. Sign Out lives in the Auth folder on purpose: it revokes `tasteep_token`, so run it only when you are done.

request.description: 204 on success, 404 if already deleted, never created, or owned by someone else.
Available bottles, newest first.
Bottles no longer listed, most recently delisted first.
A country also matches its subregions.

item.name: Admin (dashboard API)
item.description: Needs `admin_token`: a normal Tasteep bearer token for an account whose email is in the backend's ADMIN_EMAILS, from a session created within ADMIN_SESSION_MAX_HOURS (default 12h). Sign in via Tasteep — Auth, then paste the token here.

request.description: Totals, signups/day, active sessions, tastings/day by category, score histogram, top tags and distilleries.
Paginated (limit ≤ 200, offset). Optional q (email/name substring) and provider.

exec: pm.test('is a page', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.items).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(b.total).to.be.a('number'); });

request.description: One user with their sessions and tasting count. Set the :id path variable.
All users' tastings; unplaced=true keeps only location_precision unknown/country.

exec: pm.test('is a page', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.items).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(b.total).to.be.a('number'); });

request.description: Cached geocode lookups that found nothing.

exec: pm.test('is a page', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.items).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(b.total).to.be.a('number'); });

request.description: Email-OTP health: consumed / expired / pending / failed / last 24h.
Counts, last update times and scraper run state.
Fire-and-forget. 202 when started, 409 if already running.
Newest first, from the in-memory ring buffer (this process only).

exec: pm.test('is a page', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.items).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(b.total).to.be.a('number'); });

request.description: Revoke one session by id. Set the :id path variable.
Paginated (`limit`, `offset`), filter by `q` (code, distillery, extra), `category` (exact key) and `include_deleted=true`.
Where `tasteep_smws_codes` and `src/tasteep/data/smws-codes.json` disagree: `only_in_json` (inserted on next boot), `only_in_table`, `deleted_in_table`, `changed` (per-field values).
The table in the seed file format. Save over `src/tasteep/data/smws-codes.json` and commit to bring the file in line with dashboard edits.
`region_id` absent → resolved from `region`. `409` if the code is live; a deleted code is revived with these values.
Absent keys unchanged. Changing `region` without `region_id` re-resolves the link; `region_id: null` unlinks.
Soft delete: the code leaves `GET /tasteep/smws-codes` and the boot seed will not re-add it. Undo with restore.
Brings a soft-deleted code back.
Leaves the Postman test code soft-deleted, so it is out of the app list. Re-running Create revives it.

Curated distillery coordinates checked before Nominatim. Paginated (`limit`, `offset`), `q` (name or id), `include_deleted=true`. Writes (POST, PATCH /:id, DELETE /:id, POST /:id/restore) return `cache_cleared`: the geocode cache rows the name matched, evicted so the next lookup hits the curated row. POST /:id/apply places unplaced tastings whose distillery matches.
Where `tasteep_distillery_locations` and `src/tasteep/data/distillery-location.json` disagree.
The table in the seed file format. Save over `src/tasteep/data/distillery-location.json` and commit.

Same tree as `GET /tasteep/regions` plus `parent_id`, `sort_order`, `aliases`, `deleted_at`, `tasting_count`, `smws_code_count` (direct links only). `include_deleted=true` adds soft-deleted rows. Subregion ids contain `/`: URL-encode them in PATCH/DELETE/restore paths.
Where `tasteep_regions` and `src/tasteep/data/region.json` disagree (name, lat, lon, aliases; order is not compared).
The table in the seed file format. Save over `src/tasteep/data/region.json` and commit.
